title: Neurofibromatosis mentions and suicide mortality in US death records
description: Reproducible code and aggregate outputs for a proportionate mortality analysis of suicide among United States death certificates mentioning ICD-10 code Q85.0, 1999-2024. The repository contains no record-level data.

creators.name: McLean, Aaron Lawson
creators.affiliation: Department of Neurosurgery, Jena University Hospital, Friedrich Schiller University Jena
